entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I need to return something. I bought these mountain bike shoes, and I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for them.

I'm very sorry to hear you're disappointed with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To best help, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's the fit. I took them on one short ride and they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. I thought they'd be the one, you know? It's just... I really needed this to work out.

I completely understand. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. It sounds like it's a sizing or fit issue rather than a defect with the shoe's construction or the cleats compatibility. Is that correct?

Yes, I think so. The shoes themselves seem well-made. They just hurt my feet. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time, and I really need the money back if they're not going to work. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them.

Of course, and I want to reassure you. We value your loyalty, and we can absolutely get this sorted out. The good news is that our shoes have a 90-day return policy, and since you only received them a few days ago, you're well within that window. I can definitely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? A full refund? That's such a relief. Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so stressed about this.

You're very welcome. I'm happy to help. I'm sending a pre-paid return shipping label to the email on your account right now. Just package the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any postal service location. Once our warehouse receives them, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
That's wonderful. Thank you again, you've made my day so much better.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
